changelog:
- Major update adds explicit support and documentation for API-based web search (Brave Search and Baidu), with dedicated environment variables.
- Detailed network access and privacy notices now included in SKILL.md.
- Error handling and output schema improved for clarity, including new suggestions and troubleshooting sections.
- Command-line script moved to scripts/search.py; legacy scripts removed.
- Stronger "no fabrication" policy: only real, API-derived pain points are returned.
- Metadata now lists required binaries, possible API keys, and network hosts.
